title: 산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Industrial Location Policy Division - General ), 044-201-3680, 3663
Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Industrial Location Policy Division - Regeneration Projects ), 044-201-3643, 3663
Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Industrial Location Policy Division - Designation Plan, Disposal by Actual Demand ), 044-201-3678, 3675
Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Industrial Location Policy Division - Urban High-tech Industrial Complex ), 044-201-3678, 3675

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2007. 10. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Industrial Sites and Development Act and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for their implementation. <Amended Oct. 5, 2007>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(기초 조사의 실시) 국토교통부장관, 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사 및 특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)와 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)은 「산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제4조에 따라 다음 각 호의 사항에 관하여 기초조사를 실시한다. <개정 1995. 1. 9., 1996. 9. 7., 2007. 10. 5., 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 3. 30., 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Conduct of Basic Surveys) The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport; the Mayors of Special Metropolitan Cities, Metropolitan Cities, and Special Self-Governing Cities; the Governors of Provinces and Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “Mayors/Provincial Governors”); and the Mayors, County Governors, and heads of Gu (meaning heads of autonomous Gus; hereinafter the same applies) shall conduct basic surveys on the matters specified in the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 4 of the Industrial Sites and Development Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”). <Amended Jan. 9, 1995; Sep. 7, 1996; Oct. 5, 2007; Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 30, 2010; Mar. 23, 2013; Jun. 21, 2017>
1. Matters concerning the current status of industrial land use
2. Matters concerning the development status of industrial complexes

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업단지로 개발할 수 있는 후보지에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning candidate sites eligible for development into industrial complexes
4. Other matters particularly necessary for industrial location policy

rows.source_ko: 제3조(산업단지지정대장등) ① 법 제8조의2제1항 각 호 외의 부분 본문에 따른 산업단지지정권자(이하 “산업단지지정권자”라 한다)는 다음 각호의 대장을 작성ㆍ관리하고 산업단지의 지정과 산업단지개발사업시행자의 지정 및 산업단지개발사업의 시행에 관한 사항을 기록하여야 한다. <개정 2007. 12. 13., 2012. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Registers of Designated Industrial Complexes, etc.) ① The authority designating industrial complexes pursuant to the main text of Article 8-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Industrial Complex Designating Authority”) shall prepare and manage the registers specified in the following subparagraphs and record matters concerning the designation of industrial complexes, the designation of project implementers for industrial complex development projects, and the implementation of such projects. <Amended Dec. 13, 2007; Dec. 21, 2012>
1. Register of Designated Industrial Complexes ( Attachment Form No. 1 )
2. Register of Designated Project Implementers ( Attachment No. 2 )
3. Register of Industrial Complex Development Project Implementation ( Attachment Form No. 3 )

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 각 호의 대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 없으면 전자적 처리가 가능한 방법으로 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다. <신설 2007. 12. 13.>
rows.text_en: ② Unless there are special circumstances making electronic processing impossible, the ledgers referred to in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 shall be prepared and managed in a manner that enables electronic processing. <Newly added Dec. 13, 2007>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 7, 1996]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(농공단지지정승인 신청서) 「산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제10조제1항에 따른 농공단지지정승인 신청서는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Approval of Designation of an Agricultural and Industrial Complex) An application for approval of designation of an agricultural and industrial complex pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Industrial Sites and Development Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be made using Form No. 4 attached hereto.
[Wholly Amended Mar. 30, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(산업단지지정요청서 등) 영 제13조제2항에 따른 산업단지지정요청서는 별지 제5호서식에 의한다. <개정 1995. 1. 9., 1996. 9. 7., 2001. 6. 30., 2010. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Request for Designation of an Industrial Complex, etc.) A request for designation of an industrial complex pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Decree shall be made using Form No. 5 attached hereto. <Amended Jan. 9, 1995; Sep. 7, 1996; Jun. 30, 2001; Mar. 30, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(간이공작물) 영 제14조제3항제1호에서 “국토교통부령이 정하는 간이공작물”이라 함은 다음 각 호의 공작물을 말한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Simplified Structures) The term “simplified structures prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 14, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Decree means the structures specified in the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Jul. 14, 2015>
1. Vinyl greenhouse
2. Sericulture farm

rows.source_ko: 3. 고추, 잎담배, 김 등 농림수산물의 건조장
rows.text_en: 3. Drying facilities for agricultural, forestry, and fishery products such as chili peppers, leaf tobacco, and seaweed
4. Mushroom cultivation house
5. Seedling nursery
6. Compost bin
7. Threshing ground

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 제1호 내지 제7호와 유사한 것으로서 국토교통부장관이 정하여 관보에 고시하는 공작물
rows.text_en: 8. Other structures similar to those in subparagraphs 1 through 7, designated by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and announced in the Official Gazette
[Wholly Amended June 7, 2006]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(행위허가의 기준) 법 제12조제1항의 규정에 의한 행위허가는 다음 각호의 기준에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Criteria for Permission for Acts) Permission for acts pursuant to the provisions of Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with the criteria in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제6조제3항의 규정에 의한 산업단지개발계획에 적합할 것
rows.text_en: 1. It must comply with the industrial complex development plan pursuant to the provisions of Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 2. 산업단지개발사업의 착수시기 및 사업추진상황등에 비추어 보아 개발사업에 지장이 없을 것
rows.text_en: 2. There shall be no impediment to the development project in light of the commencement timing and progress of the industrial complex development project.

rows.source_ko: 3. 기타 주변의 교통ㆍ경관 및 환경등의 여건에 적합할 것
rows.text_en: 3. It shall be suitable for other surrounding conditions, such as traffic, scenery, and the environment.
[This Article was newly established on Sep. 7, 1996.]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의3(준공된 단지의 개발행위 절차 등) ① 법 제13조의4제1항 각 호의 외의 행위를 하려는 자는 산업단지지정권자로부터 법 제16조에 따른 사업시행자 지정을 받아야 한다. <개정 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-3 (Procedures for Development Activities, etc. in Completed Industrial Complexes) ① A person who intends to perform an act other than those specified in the subparagraphs of Article 13-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be designated as a project implementer by the industrial complex designating authority pursuant to Article 16 of the Act. <Amended Jul. 15, 2014; Jun. 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 사업시행자 지정을 받은 자는 법 제17조부터 제19조까지의 규정에 따른 실시계획을 작성하여 산업단지지정권자의 승인을 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who has been designated as a project implementer pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall prepare an implementation plan in accordance with the provisions of Articles 17 through 19 of the Act and obtain approval from the authority designating the industrial complex.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 사업시행자 지정신청은 제2항에 따른 실시계획 승인신청과 함께 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ An application for designation of a project implementer pursuant to Paragraph 1 may be made together with an application for approval of an implementation plan pursuant to Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항 및 제2항에도 불구하고 법 제13조의4제2항에 따라 영 제15조의4제2호 및 제2호의2의 행위를 하려는 자는 「산업집적활성화 및 공장설립에 관한 법률」 제33조에 따라 산업단지관리기본계획을 변경하여 해당 행위를 할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ④ Notwithstanding Paragraphs 1 and 2, any person who intends to perform the acts specified in Subparagraphs 2 and 2-2 of Article 15-4 of the Enforcement Decree pursuant to Paragraph 2 of Article 13-4 of the Act may perform such acts by amending the Basic Plan for Industrial Complex Management pursuant to Article 33 of the Industrial Cluster Development and Factory Establishment Act . <Amended July 15, 2014; June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항 및 제2항에도 불구하고 법 제13조의4제2항에 따라 영 제15조의4제3호부터 제5호까지의 규정에 따른 행위 중 어느 하나에 해당하는 행위를 하려는 자는 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률」, 「도로법」, 「폐기물처리시설 설치촉진 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률」 등 관계 법령이 정하는 바에 따라 해당 행위를 할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Notwithstanding Paragraphs 1 and 2, any person who intends to perform any of the acts specified in Subparagraphs 3 through 5 of Article 15-4 of the Enforcement Decree pursuant to Paragraph 2 of Article 13-4 of the Act may perform such acts in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, such as the National Land Planning and Utilization Act , the Road Act , and the Act on Promotion of Installation of Waste Treatment Facilities and Support for Surrounding Areas, etc. <Amended July 15, 2014; June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제13조의4제1항 각 호의 행위 외의 행위를 완료한 자는 그 사실을 산업단지지정권자에게 통보하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Any person who has completed an act other than those specified in each subparagraph of Article 13-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall notify the authority designating the industrial complex of such fact. <Amended July 15, 2014; June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 법 제13조의4제1항 각 호의 개발행위에 해당하여 산업단지지정권자가 산업단지개발계획을 변경하려는 경우에는 법 제6조, 제7조, 제7조의2, 제7조의3, 제7조의4, 제8조 및 제10조의 규정에 따른 해당 산업단지개발계획 변경에 관한 사항을 준용한다. <신설 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Where the authority designating an industrial complex intends to amend the industrial complex development plan in accordance with any development activity falling under the subparagraphs of Article 13-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the matters concerning the amendment of the relevant industrial complex development plan pursuant to the provisions of Articles 6 , 7 , 7-2 , 7-3 , 7-4 , 8 , and 10 of the Act shall apply mutatis mutandis. <Newly added July 15, 2014; June 21, 2017>
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 5, 2007]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(사업시행자지정신청서등) ①영 제19조제4항의 규정에 의한 사업시행자지정신청서는 별지 제6호서식에 의한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Designation of a Project Implementer, etc.) ① An application for designation of a project implementer pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 4 of the Decree shall be made using Form No. 6 attached hereto. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996>

rows.source_ko: ②산업단지지정권자는 법 제16조의 규정에 의하여 사업시행자를 지정한 경우에는 별지 제7호서식에 의한 사업시행자지정서를 신청인에게 교부하여야 한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where the authority designating an industrial complex designates a project implementer pursuant to the provisions of Article 16 of the Act , it shall issue a Certificate of Designation of Project Implementer in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form to the applicant. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(개발사업대행신청서 등) ① 영 제20조제6항에 따른 산업단지개발사업 대행신청서는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다. <개정 2014. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Agency for Development Projects, etc.) ① The application for agency for industrial complex development projects pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form. <Amended July 15, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제20조의2제1항에 따른 산업단지개발사업 대행승인신청서는 별지 제8호의2서식에 따른다. <개정 2014. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The application for approval of agency for industrial complex development projects pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8-2 of the Attached Form. <Amended July 15, 2014>
[Wholly Amended Nov. 23, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(실시계획승인신청서등) ①영 제21조제1항ㆍ영 제22조제1항ㆍ영 제22조의2제1항 및 영 제23조제1항에 따른 국가산업단지개발실시계획승인신청서ㆍ일반산업단지개발실시계획승인신청서ㆍ도시첨단산업단지개발실시계획승인신청서 및 농공단지개발실시계획승인신청서는 별지 제9호서식에 의한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7., 2007. 10. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Approval of an Implementation Plan, etc.) ① Applications for approval of implementation plans for the development of national industrial complexes, general industrial complexes, urban high-tech industrial complexes, and agricultural and industrial complexes pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 1; Article 22, Paragraph 1; Article 22-2, Paragraph 1; and Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Decree, respectively, shall be made using Form No. 9 attached hereto. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996; Oct. 5, 2007>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제21조제2항제3호에서 “국토교통부령이 정하는 매립공사설명서”라 함은 「공유수면 관리 및 매립에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제29조제2항제5호에 따른 매립공사설명서를 말한다. <신설 2001. 6. 30., 2007. 10. 5., 2008. 3. 14., 2010. 10. 15., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 21, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “description of reclamation work prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the description of reclamation work pursuant to Article 29, Paragraph 2 , Subparagraph 5 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Management and Reclamation of Public Waters . <Newly added June 30, 2001; October 5, 2007; March 14, 2008; October 15, 2010; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③영 제21조제3항ㆍ영 제22조제3항ㆍ영 제22조의2제3항 및 영 제23조제3항에 따른 실시계획승인신청기간의 연장신청은 별지 제10호서식에 의한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7., 2007. 10. 5.>
rows.text_en: ③ An application for an extension of the application period for approval of an implementation plan pursuant to Article 21 , Paragraph 3 , Article 22, Paragraph 3, Article 22-2, Paragraph 3, and Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996; Oct. 5, 2007>

rows.source_ko: ④제3항에 따른 신청서에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. <신설 1995. 1. 9., 1996. 9. 7., 2007. 10. 5.>
rows.text_en: ④ The application form under Paragraph 3 shall be accompanied by the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Jan. 9, 1995; Sep. 7, 1996; Oct. 5, 2007>
1. Location Map
2. Statement of Reason for Extension of Application Period

rows.source_ko: 제10조(위탁료율기준) ①영 제24조제4항에 따라 산업단지개발사업을 위탁하는 경우의 위탁료율기준은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 1996. 9. 7., 2007. 10. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Standards for Entrustment Fee Rates) ① The standards for entrustment fee rates for cases where industrial complex development projects are entrusted pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996; Oct. 5, 2007>
② Deleted <October 5, 2007>

rows.source_ko: 제10조의2(매입대금의 분할납부) 영 제25조제5항에 따라 매입대금을 분할납부하고자 하는 공공사업시행자는 매매계약의 체결시까지 「국유재산법 시행규칙」 제36조제2항에 따른 중앙관서의 장등에 별지 제10호의2서식에 의한 국유재산매입대금분할납부신청서를 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2007. 10. 5., 2012. 12. 21., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 10-2 (Installment Payment of Purchase Price) A public works project operator who intends to pay the purchase price in installments pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 5 of the Decree shall, by the time the sales contract is concluded, submit an application for installment payment of the purchase price of state-owned property in Form No. 10-2 to the head of the competent central government agency, etc., pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rule of the State Property Act. <Amended Oct. 5, 2007; Dec. 21, 2012; Jun. 21, 2017>
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2001.]
Article 10-3 Deleted <June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(부담금납부통지서) 영 제31조제6항에 따른 시설부담금의 납부통지는 별지 제11호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Notice of Payment of Charges) The notice of payment of facility charges pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 11 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Oct. 5, 2007]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(준공인가신청서등) ①영 제36조제1항의 규정에 의한 준공인가신청서는 별지 제12호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Application for Approval of Completion, etc.) ① An application for approval of completion pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Decree shall be made using Form No. 12 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: ②영 제36조제4항의 규정에 의한 준공인가필증은 별지 제13호서식에 의한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of approval for completion pursuant to the provisions of Article 36, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 13 of the Attached Form. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996>

rows.source_ko: ③개발사업실시계획의 승인권자는 법 제37조제4항 및 영 제36조제6항에 따라 준공인가에 관한 공고를 하는 경우에는 관보 또는 당해지방자치단체의 공보로써 이를 행하여야 한다. <개정 1995. 1. 9., 1996. 9. 7., 2012. 12. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ Where the authority approving the implementation plan for a development project publicly announces approval of completion pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 4 of the Act and Article 36, Paragraph 6 of the Decree, the announcement shall be made through the Official Gazette or the official gazette of the relevant local government. <Amended Jan. 9, 1995; Sep. 7, 1996; Dec. 21, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(준공인가전사용신청서) 영 제37조제1항 및 제2항에 따른 준공인가전사용신청서는 별지 제14호서식에 의한다. <개정 2008. 9. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Application for Use Prior to Completion Approval) The application for use prior to completion approval pursuant to Article 37, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 14 of the Attached Form . <Amended Sep. 29, 2008>
[Wholly Amended Apr. 12, 1999]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(개발토지ㆍ시설등의 분양계획서) ①영 제39조제1항의 규정에 의한 개발토지ㆍ시설등의 분양계획서는 별지 제15호서식에 의한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Plan for the Sale of Developed Land, Facilities, etc.) ① The plan for the sale of developed land, facilities, etc. pursuant to the provisions of Article 39, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 15 of the Attached Form. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의한 계획서에는 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. <신설 1995. 1. 9.>
rows.text_en: ② The plan pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Jan. 9, 1995>
1. Detailed Sales Plan by Business Type
2. Sales Plan Survey and Drawings
Article 15 Deleted <October 5, 2007>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(개발토지ㆍ시설등의 임대계획서) ①영 제41조제1항의 규정에 의한 개발토지ㆍ시설등의 임대사업계획서는 별지 제17호서식에 의한다. <개정 1996. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Lease Plan for Developed Land, Facilities, etc.) ① The lease business plan for developed land, facilities, etc. pursuant to Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 17 of the Attached Form. <Amended Sep. 7, 1996>
② Deleted <September 7, 1996>

rows.source_ko: ③제1항의 규정에 의한 계획서에는 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. <신설 1995. 1. 9., 1996. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ The plan pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Jan. 9, 1995; Sep. 7, 1996>
1. Location Map
2. Map of Complex Development Status

rows.source_ko: 3. 임대하고자 하는 토지ㆍ시설등의 조서 및 도면
rows.text_en: 3. Survey and drawings of the land, facilities, etc. to be leased
4. Post-management and Operation Plan
[Title amended Sep. 7, 1996]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(임대요율) 영 제42조제1항제2호에서 “국토교통부령이 정하는 임대요율”이라 함은 사업시행자가 영 제42조의3제1항에 따른 처분계획의 공고를 한 날 현재 계약기간 1년의 정기예금이자율(특별시에 본점을 둔 시중은행의 이자율을 평균한 것을 말한다)을 말한다. <개정 1995. 1. 9., 1996. 9. 7., 2007. 10. 5., 2008. 3. 14., 2012. 12. 21., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Rental Rate) In Article 42, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “rental rate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the interest rate on time deposits with a contract period of one year as of the date the project implementer has made public notice of the disposition plan pursuant to Article 42-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree (referring to the average of the interest rates of commercial banks with their head offices in a Special City). <Amended Jan. 9, 1995; Sep. 7, 1996; Oct. 5, 2007; Mar. 14, 2008; Dec. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(협력기업) 영 제43조의3제1항에 따른 협력기업은 이전기업으로부터 물품ㆍ반제품 및 원료 등의 제조ㆍ가공ㆍ수리ㆍ운반 또는 판매 등을 위탁받아 이전기업의 제품 생산에 필요한 재화나 용역을 제공하는 기업을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Cooperating Enterprise) A cooperating enterprise pursuant to Article 43-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to an enterprise that receives a commission from a transferring enterprise for the manufacture, processing, repair, transportation, or sale of goods, semi-finished products, and raw materials, etc., and provides goods or services necessary for the production of products by the transferring enterprise.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 29, 2008]
Article 19 Deleted <September 7, 1996>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(증표) 법 제47조제3항의 규정에 의한 증표는 별지 제19호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Identification) The identification pursuant to the provisions of Article 47, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 19 of the Attached Form .
Article 21 Deleted <April 7, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(재생사업지구 지정대장 등) ① 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 다음 각 호의 대장을 작성ㆍ관리하고 산업단지 재생사업지구(이하 “재생사업지구”라 한다)의 지정과 산업단지 재생사업(이하 “재생사업”이라 한다) 시행자의 지정 및 재생사업의 시행에 관한 사항을 기록하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Registers of Designated Industrial Complex Regeneration Project Districts, etc.) ① The Mayor/Provincial Governor or the Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu shall prepare and manage the registers specified in the following subparagraphs and record matters concerning the designation of industrial complex regeneration project districts (hereinafter referred to as “regeneration project districts”), the designation of implementers of industrial complex regeneration projects (hereinafter referred to as “regeneration projects”), and the implementation of regeneration projects.
1. Register of Designated Regeneration Project Districts ( Attachment Form No. 1 )
2. Register of Designated Project Implementers ( Attachment No. 2 )
3. Regeneration Project Implementation Register ( Attachment Form No. 3 )

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 각 호의 대장의 작성ㆍ관리에 관하여는 제3조제2항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: ② The provisions of Article 3, Paragraph 2 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the preparation and management of the ledgers in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 .
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2010.]

rows.source_ko: 제23조(재생사업지구지정신청서 등) ① 영 제44조의4에 따라 준용되는 영 제13조제2항에 따른 재생사업지구지정요청서는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Application for Designation of a Regeneration Project District, etc.) ① A request for designation of a regeneration project district pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Decree, as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 44-4 of the Decree, shall be made using Form No. 5 attached hereto. <Amended Jun. 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제44조의9제1항에 따라 준용되는 영 제19조제4항에 따른 사업시행자지정신청서는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다. <개정 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The application for designation of a project implementer pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree , which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form . <Amended July 15, 2014; June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제39조의10제1항 본문에 따라 준용되는 법 제16조에 따라 재생사업 시행자를 지정한 경우에는 별지 제7호서식에 따른 사업시행자지정서를 신청인에게 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where a regeneration project implementer is designated pursuant to Article 16 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the main text of Article 39-10, Paragraph 1 of the Act, a certificate of designation of the project implementer in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form shall be issued to the applicant.

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제44조의9제1항에 따라 준용되는 영 제20조제6항에 따른 재생사업에 대한 대행신청서는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다. <개정 2014. 7. 15., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ④ The application for agency for regeneration projects under Article 20, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree , which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form. <Amended July 15, 2014; June 21, 2017>
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2010.]

rows.source_ko: 제24조(재생사업에 대한 동의서 등) ① 영 제44조의8제2항에 따른 동의서, 동의철회서 및 대표자 지정동의서는 각각 별지 제18호서식, 제18호의2서식 및 제18호의3서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Consent Forms, etc. for Regeneration Projects) ① The consent form, withdrawal of consent form, and consent form for designation of a representative pursuant to Article 44-8 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Forms No. 18 , No. 18-2 , and No. 18-3 of the Attached Forms . <Amended June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 동의철회서는 재생사업 시행자 또는 시행자가 되려는 자에게 인감증명서를 첨부하여 「우편법 시행규칙」 제25조제1항제4호가목에 따른 내용증명으로 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The withdrawal of consent pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be submitted to the regeneration project implementer or the person intending to become the implementer by attaching a certificate of seal impression and by means of a certified letter pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1, Item 4, Subparagraph (a) of the Enforcement Rules of the Postal Act .
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2010.]

rows.source_ko: 제25조(재생시행계획의 승인 등) ① 영 제44조의5제1항에 따른 재생시행계획 승인신청서는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Approval, etc. of Regeneration Implementation Plan) ① The application for approval of a regeneration implementation plan pursuant to Article 44-5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form. <Amended June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제44조의5제2항제2호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 매립공사설명서”란 제9조제2항에 따른 매립공사설명서를 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 44-5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “statement of landfill construction prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the description of reclamation work pursuant to Article 9 , Paragraph 2. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Jun. 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제44조의5제3항에 따른 재생사업 승인신청기간의 연장신청은 별지 제10호서식에 따른다. 이 경우 첨부서류에 관하여는 제9조제4항을 준용한다. <개정 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ An application for an extension of the application period for approval of a regeneration project pursuant to Article 44-5, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form. In this case, Article 9, Paragraph 4 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the attached documents . <Amended June 21, 2017>
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2010.]

rows.source_ko: 제26조(재생사업의 시설부담금 납부통지 등) 재생사업에 관한 시설부담금의 납부통지 등에 관하여는 다음 각 호의 서식에 따른다. <개정 2017. 6. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Notice of Payment of Facility Charges for Regeneration Projects, etc.) The notice of payment, etc. regarding facility charges related to regeneration projects shall be in accordance with the forms set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제44조의9제1항 본문에 따라 준용되는 영 제31조제6항에 따른 시설부담금의 납부통지: 별지 제11호서식
rows.text_en: 1. Notice of Payment of Facility Charges Pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree , which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the main text of Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree: Form No. 11

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제44조의9제1항 본문에 따라 준용되는 영 제36조제1항에 따른 준공인가신청서 및 영 제36조제4항에 따른 준공인가필증: 별지 제12호서식 및 별지 제13호서식
rows.text_en: 2. Application for approval of completion pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the main text of Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, and Certificate of Approval of Completion pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree: Form No. 12 and Form No. 13

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제44조의9제1항 본문에 따라 준용되는 영 제37조제1항 및 제2항에 따른 준공인가전사용신청서: 별지 제14호서식
rows.text_en: 3. Application for Use Prior to Completion Approval Pursuant to Article 37, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Enforcement Decree , which are applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the main text of Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree: Form No. 14

rows.source_ko: 4. 영 제44조의9제1항 본문에 따라 준용되는 영 제39조제1항에 따른 분양계획서: 별지 제15호서식. 이 경우 첨부서류에 관하여는 제14조제2항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: 4. A plan for sale pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the main text of Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree: Form No. 15. In this case , Article 14, Paragraph 2 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the attached documents .

rows.source_ko: 5. 영 제44조의9제1항 본문에 따라 준용되는 영 제41조제1항에 따른 임대사업계획서: 별지 제17호서식. 이 경우 첨부서류에 관하여는 제16조제3항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: 5. Rental business plan pursuant to Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , which is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the main text of Article 44-9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree: Form No. 17. In this case , Article 16, Paragraph 3 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the attached documents .
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2010.]

rows.source_ko: 제27조(재생사업에의 준용 등) 제6조ㆍ제6조의2(법 제39조의10제1항 단서에 따라 법 제12조가 준용되는 경우에 한정한다), 제10조, 제10조의2, 제10조의3, 제17조 및 제21조의 규정은 산업단지 재생사업에 준용한다. 이 경우 “산업단지개발사업”은 “재생사업”으로, “개발사업실시계획”은 “재생시행계획”으로, “실시계획승인권자”는 “재생시행계획승인권자”로, “산업단지개발기간”은 “재생사업기간”으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Application Mutatis Mutandis to Regeneration Projects, etc.) The provisions of Article 6 , Article 6-2 (limited to cases where Article 12 of the Act is applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the proviso to Article 39-10 , Paragraph 1 of the Act ), Article 10 , Article 10-2 , Article 10-3 , Article 17 , and Article 21 shall apply mutatis mutandis to industrial complex regeneration projects. In this case, “industrial complex development project” shall be deemed “regeneration project,” “development project implementation plan” as “regeneration implementation plan,” “authority approving the implementation plan” as “authority approving the regeneration implementation plan,” and “industrial complex development period” as “regeneration project period.”
[This Article was newly established on March 30, 2010.]

rows.source_ko: 제27조의2(입주기업 종사자 등의 주택공급 절차) 영 제47조의4제2항에 따라 입주기업 종사자 등에 특별공급되는 주택의 입주자격 및 선정방법은 「주택공급에 관한 규칙」에서 정하는 바에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 27-2 (Procedure for Housing Supply to Employees, etc. of Tenant Companies) The qualifications and selection methods for housing specially supplied to employees, etc. of tenant companies pursuant to Article 47-4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the provisions of the “Rules on Housing Supply.”

[This Article was newly added on July 15, 2014.]
[Formerly Article 27-2 was moved to Article 27-3 <July 15, 2014>]
Article 27-3 Deleted <December 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제28조(과징금의 납부통지) ① 영 제50조제1항에 따른 과징금의 납부 통지는 별지 제20호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Notice of Payment of Penalty Surcharge) ① A notice of payment of a penalty surcharge pursuant to Article 50, Paragraph 1 of the Decree shall be in Form No. 20 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: ② 산업단지지정권자는 별지 제21호서식의 과징금처분대장을 갖추어 두고, 과징금의 부과ㆍ징수에 관한 사항을 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The authority designating an industrial complex shall keep a ledger of penalty surcharges in the form of Annex 21 and record and manage matters concerning the imposition and collection of penalty surcharges.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 21, 2012]
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction Decree No. 476, Jan. 25, 1991>

rows.source_ko: ①(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: ②(폐지법령) 산업기지개발촉진법시행규칙 및 지방공업개발법시행규칙은 이를 각각 폐지한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Repealed Acts) The Enforcement Rules of the Industrial Base Development Promotion Act and the Enforcement Rules of the Local Industrial Development Act are hereby repealed.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 4, Jan. 9, 1995>

rows.source_ko: ①(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: ②(서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 종전의 규정에 의한 서식은 이 규칙 시행일부터 2월간 이 규칙에 의한 서식과 함께 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional measures regarding forms) Forms under the previous regulations at the time of enforcement of this rule may be used together with the forms under this rule for two months from the date of enforcement of this rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 79, Sep. 7, 1996>
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 182, Apr. 12, 1999>
This Rule shall enter into force on May 6, 1999.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 287, June 30, 2001>
① (Enforcement Date) This Rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2001.
